ell_m.scope: sufficient common choice, independent of j

K_m.scope: independent of correction stage j; explicit formula not given here

ell_prime_m.scope: depends only on m and ell_(m+1); independent of J; explicit formula not given

m0_vs_positive_branch.minimum_J: J>=max(1,m), hence m=0 and m=1 both require J>=1

one_power_absorption.scope: fixed J then shrink q-neighborhood to absorb logs by one q power; proof margin, not a formula fixing K_m

interpretation: Alternative sufficient bounds are not rejected merely because they differ from p114 common choice; actual derivation and same-source applicability must be checked.
